The '''MG9 proton torpedo launcher''' was a model of [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]] manufactured by [[Krupx Munitions/Legends|Krupx Munitions]]. Two MG9s were installed in the [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="EGVV" /> Each launcher was capable of holding six [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
